title: Checkout UI extension / customizer conflict
likely: A checkout app (upsell, trust badges, delivery date, tips) is injecting a block that fails validation or hides Pay.
test_sequence: Settings → Checkout → Customize.
Unpublish the most recently added checkout app block.
Open a fresh incognito checkout.
If Pay returns, leave that block off or update the app.

title: Shipping app returned zero rates
likely: The shipping app is the only rate in the zone and returned nothing (weight, origin, or token).
test_sequence: Add a native flat rate in the same zone.
Retest checkout. If rates appear, the app is the culprit.
Reconnect the carrier account or fix product weights.
Keep the flat rate as a fallback.

title: Theme app embed / leftover section
likely: An embed writes into header/cart and breaks compile, or a leftover block remains after a theme switch.
test_sequence: Duplicate the theme.
Customize → App embeds → disable all → preview.
Re-enable one at a time until the error returns.
Update or remove that app.

title: Fraud / risk app auto-cancelling
likely: A fraud app or native filter is cancelling or blocking capture on legitimate cards.
test_sequence: Open a declined/cancelled order timeline and look for the app name.
Set the app to review instead of cancel.
Retry a known-good card.
Loosen native Fraud protect if it is stacked with a third-party app.

title: Currency converter vs Markets
patterns: unable to process in this currency
likely: A legacy converter is fighting Shopify Markets / Payments multi-currency.
test_sequence: Disable the currency app embed.
Preview Markets native currency.
If checkout charges correctly, uninstall the converter.

title: Subscription app vs gateway
likely: The gateway or Shop Pay does not support the selling plan, or the app is outdated for checkout extensibility.
test_sequence: Place a one-time (non-subscription) test. If that works, the app/gateway pairing is the issue.
Update the subscription app.
Confirm the gateway supports recurring on your plan.

title: App marked outdated / unsupported
likely: Shopify flagged the app after a platform change. It may still be installed and breaking save or checkout.
test_sequence: Settings → Apps → filter by outdated / needs attention.
Update if an update exists.
If not, disable then uninstall and retest the failing page.
